get.description: This operation returns a summary for the HTML full text or PDF full text document based on record id and opid.

parameters.name: recordid
parameters.description: Record Identifier. EBSCO record identifier for the content item.

parameters.name: fulltextType
parameters.description: Format of the full-text document to summarize. Valid values: html or pdf. Default is html.

parameters.name: opid
parameters.description: Opaque Profile Identifier. Governs user entitlements and content access rights. Provisioned by EBSCO. Example: 4ovgdm

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Preferred language for the summary response. Supports ISO 639-1 language codes (e.g., en, es, fr, de, ja, zh). Default: en

• Mutual fund managers exposed to abnormally hot temperatures are significantly more likely to support climate proposals, indicating that personal experience with climate change affects voting behavior.
  • The effect of exposure to hot temperatures on voting support is specific to climate proposals, not other types of shareholder proposals, suggesting it is not due to omitted factors.

post.description: This operation executes a comprehensive search across all or selected databases within the consumer's profile. The operation supports advanced search capabilities including filters, facets, expanders, search modes, and custom actions. The response contains record counts, results list and applied filters.

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: The media data type. application/json

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: HTTP 1.1 Accept-Language header. See (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Headers/Accept-Language). Indicates the preferred language(s) for the response. This information is used to localize response content when multiple language variants are available. Language tags with higher language weight (q) values represent higher preference. If no q value is provided, it defaults to 1.0. Format: A comma separate list of language tags, optionally including language weights (q) to indicate preference order.

parameters.name: includeResponseItems
parameters.description: Specifies a comma-separated list of items to include in the response. Consumers can use this parameter to control the data returned by the API.

parameters.name: applyAllLimiters
parameters.description: Determines how limiters are processed by the search endpoint. Set to true to process all limiters from the pre-search configuration, including both common and specialized limiters. The default value is false, which processes only the limiters from the common filter endpoint. It is recommended to set this to true, as limiters associated with the false flag will be deprecated soon.

parameters.name: excludeLinks
parameters.description: Set this optional parameter to true to exclude links from the response

AdvancedSearchStrategyEnum.title: AdvancedSearchStrategyEnum.V5
AdvancedSearchStrategyEnum.description: Enumeration describing the advanced search strategy configured for a customer profile in the admin settings. This parameter is included in both the search API request and response. Possible values are: - NONE: No advanced search strategy is applied. This is the default value in search API requests. - SMART_TEXT_FAILOVER: Enables SmartText failover strategy. When SmartText is requested, the API will attempt to return results for similar search terms.
